name: Wolf Form
description: When you mark one or more Hit Points, you can also mark a Stress to enter your Wolf Form. While in this form, gain a d10 Wolf Die that you add to all attack and damage rolls. When you would gain a Hope while in Wolf Form, you mark a Stress instead.
